assertions.text: The enhancements summary itself lists features not yet implemented, including an agent feedback loop, static analysis tool integration (pylint/flake8/mypy), smart diff-only reviews, performance profiling, and specialized agents.
A parallel executor is documented offering three modes: sequential, parallel, and hybrid (parallel groups with sequential flow), using asyncio and ThreadPoolExecutor.
Reports are documented to be generated in four formats: HTML, Markdown, SARIF, and JSON, using Jinja2 templates.
GitHub integration is documented to post PR review comments and inline comments via the GitHub API using a user-supplied token, and can approve or request changes based on quality.

Documented dependencies include Python 3.9+, Google Gemini as the LLM, Rich for terminal UI, Jinja2 for reports, PyGithub for GitHub API access, and aiohttp for async execution; pylint, flake8, mypy, and safety are listed as future-use dependencies.

The architecture uses sequential agent execution where each agent receives context from prior agents, with a MemoryBank for context sharing and compaction, per the README and checklist.

Documented components include a CodeReviewOrchestrator in main.py, three agent modules, custom AST-based code analysis tools, and utility modules for sessions, memory, reporting, parallel execution, retries, multi-language analysis, GitHub integration, and observability.

Repository development practice: the checklist instructs verifying the project by installing requirements, exporting GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY, then running python main.py, python test_system.py, and examples/sample_usage.py.
